accessibilityHint.description:
An accessibility hint helps users understand what will happen when they perform an action on the
accessibility element when that result is not clear from the accessibility label

accessibilityLabel.description: VoiceOver will read this string when a user selects the associated element

assistiveText.description: Text that helps the user understand the input

autoComplete.description:
Determines which content to suggest on auto complete, e.g.`username`.
Default is `off` which disables auto complete

*Android Only*

autoFocus.description: Automatically focus the input after it is rendered

clearable.description:
Add a clear action on the input that clears the value.

You should always use `while-editing` if you want the input to be
clearable. if the input value isn't editable (i.e. `InputDateTime`) you can
set it to `always`.

invalid.description: Highlights the field red and shows message below (if string) to indicate an error

loadingType.description: Change the type of loading indicator to spinner or glimmer.

multiline.description:
Determines if inputText will span multiple lines.
Default is `false`

https://reactnative.dev/docs/textinput#multiline

onBlur.description: Callback that is called when the text input is blurred

onFocus.description:
Callback that is called when the text input is focused
@param event

onSubmitEditing.description:
Callback that is called when the text input's submit button is pressed
@param event

placeholder.description: Hint text that goes above the value once the field is filled out

prefix.description: Symbol to display before the text input

showMiniLabel.description:
Controls the visibility of the mini label that appears inside the input
when a value is entered. By default, the placeholder text moves up to
become a mini label. Set to false to disable this behavior.

spellCheck.description:
Determines whether spell check is used. Turn it off to hide empty autoCorrect
suggestions when autoCorrect is off.

*iOS Only*

styleOverride.description: Custom styling to override default style of the input text

suffix.description: Symbol to display after the text input

type.name: { icon?: IconNames; label?: string; onPress?: () => void; }

testID.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests

textContentType.description:
Determines which content to suggest on auto complete, e.g.`username`.
Default is `none` which disables auto complete

*iOS Only*

toolbar.description: Add a toolbar below the input field for actions like rewriting the text.

toolbarVisibility.description: Change the behaviour of when the toolbar becomes visible.

transform.description:
transform object is used to transform the internal TextInput value
It's useful for components like InputNumber where we want to transform
the internal value to a number.
"input" is a function that transform the value to the string format that should be shown to the user
"output" is a function that transform the string representation of the value to the value that is sent to onChange and the form

type.name: { input?: (v: any) => string; output?: (v: string) => any; }

validations.description: Shows an error message below the field and highlight the field red when value is invalid
